title: baseline: defaults (M0, before any building)
notes: Level with the top nation at minute 1 on 3 of 6 maps, then half its land by minute 3.
Tribes hold 37-96% of the land at minute 1 and nations eat most of it by minute 3; the baseline sits that race out.
Stalls and is eaten between minutes 6 and 14 on 4 of 6 maps; never leaves its home islands on ArchipelagoSea.
Nations nuke from minutes 4-7 in every game.

title: baseline: expandTrigger, expandReserve varied
notes: Both variants survive longer than the defaults (Europe: out at 23.7 and 28.1 min against 6.9) but do not grow: peak land stays at 2-5% on World, Europe and Alps.
Keeping 42% home dies early on ArchipelagoSea (13.5 min; the defaults survive the hour) and on Alps (5.6 min).
Mena is the exception: keeping 10% home reaches 13.3% before it is eaten at 25.2 min.
A longer-lived agent slows the nations: with 10% home no nation wins World within the hour, and on Mena the winner changes from Azerbaijan at 17.5 min to Lebanon at 36.6.
The reserve moves survival, not the stall; the fix is structural (H3 tribe race, H5 strikes), as the 20-game sweep in the ledger found.
